articles.title: PBM Rebate Reform and Its Impact on Biosimilar Formulary Adoption
articles.summary: As policymakers push for PBM rebate reform, questions arise over how shifting away from traditional rebate models will impact biosimilar uptake and formulary positioning. This shift directly affects self-funded employers seeking cost-effective specialty drug alternatives and lower net drug spend. Understanding these market dynamics is critical for pharmacy benefit strategies regarding high-cost specialty medications.
articles.source_line: Source: Center for Biosimilars; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 18:53:47 GMT

articles.title: DOL Finalizes New PBM Transparency Rule Impacting Employer Health Plans
articles.summary: The Department of Labor has finalized new transparency regulations governing pharmacy benefit managers and self-funded employer health plans. This rule imposes stricter disclosure requirements on PBMs regarding pricing, fees, and compensation, directly empowering plan sponsors to audit and evaluate their benefit costs. Self-funded employers must review their existing PBM contracts to ensure compliance and take advantage of these enhanced transparency provisions.
articles.source_line: Source: The National Law Review; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:37:24 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Positions Biosimilars at the Center of Drug Coverage Strategies
articles.summary: CVS Health is making biosimilars a central pillar of its drug coverage and formulary management to drive down specialty drug costs. This shift impacts major PBM formulary strategies and offers significant cost-saving opportunities for self-funded employer health plans navigating high-cost biologic therapies.
articles.source_line: Source: Simply Wall St; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 02:40:40 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Restructuring Signals Major Shifts in PBM Market Power
articles.summary: Industry analysis examines the strategic implications of a potential CVS Health breakup on the pharmaceutical supply chain and PBM market dynamics. For self-funded employers, structural shifts among major PBMs could alter pricing transparency, competitive contracting options, and rebate models. The evaluation highlights how evolving vertical integration models directly impact commercial health plan cost management.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmaceutical Commerce; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:04:02 GMT

articles.title: Waud Capital Exits PromptCare in Major Specialty Pharmacy Deal
articles.summary: Waud Capital Partners announced the sale of PromptCare Infusion, creating a new national specialty pharmacy platform. This transaction highlights ongoing private equity consolidation within the specialty pharmacy space, a critical sector for self-funded employers managing high-cost drug therapies.

articles.title: Bipartisan Bill Introduced in Congress to Preserve 340B Drug Discounts
articles.summary: Lawmakers have introduced bipartisan legislation aimed at protecting critical drug discounts for safety-net providers under the 340B program. This policy development is significant for self-funded employers and PBMs monitoring ongoing federal 340B reform efforts and their broader impact on drug pricing and market dynamics.
articles.source_line: Source: U.S. Representative Jack Bergman (.gov); Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:02:59 GMT

articles.title: Employers Brace to Shift Rising Healthcare Costs to Workers by 2028
articles.summary: A new report indicates that US employers are preparing to shift a greater portion of escalating healthcare costs onto their employees over the next few years. This trend highlights the ongoing affordability crisis for self-funded plans and underscores the urgent need for better cost management strategies, such as PBM optimization and specialty drug containment, to protect plan members.
articles.source_line: Source: South Florida Reporter; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 06:12:22 GMT

articles.title: Ohio Skeptics Question CVS Health Restructuring and PBM Separation
articles.summary: CVS Health has announced structural changes, but local critics and state officials in Ohio argue the breakup does not go far enough to address vertical integration concerns within the PBM industry. For self-funded employers, ongoing scrutiny of major PBM structures signals continued state-level legislative pressure and potential changes to pharmacy benefit contracting.
articles.source_line: Source: Ohio Capital Journal; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:08:59 GMT

articles.title: Payer Restrictions and Eosinophil Thresholds Shape COPD Biologic Utilization
articles.summary: Recent analysis highlights how commercial payers and PBMs utilize strict clinical criteria, such as eosinophil thresholds, to manage access and control the high costs associated with biologics for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). This trend underscores how self-funded health plans are increasingly relying on utilization management tools to navigate emerging specialty drug costs.
articles.source_line: Source: The American Journal of Managed Care; Wed, 11 Nov 2026
articles.source_name: The American Journal of Managed Care

articles.title: CVS Health Accelerates Biosimilar Push to Capture Specialty Drug Savings
articles.summary: CVS Health is aggressively moving to adopt and prioritize biosimilars within its pharmacy benefit management framework to curb skyrocketing specialty drug costs. This strategic shift signals increased market competition and potential cost-mitigation opportunities for self-funded employers managing high-cost biologic therapies.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 03:12:00 GMT

articles.title: Cigna Targets $45 EPS by 2030 Amid Specialty Pharmacy Growth
articles.summary: Cigna Group has announced a long-term earnings target of $45 per share by 2030, driven heavily by specialty pharmacy growth offsetting broader headwinds in the pharmacy sector. This financial strategy highlights how major PBMs and health conglomerates are increasingly leaning into specialty drug management to sustain margins. For self-funded employers, this underscores the growing financial weight of specialty therapeutics within plan spend.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 07:14:00 GMT

articles.title: Florida Regulators Penalize PBMs Over $12 Million for Violations
articles.summary: Florida's Office of Insurance Regulation has levied more than $12.66 million in fines against major PBMs for regulatory violations. This enforcement action highlights increasing state-level scrutiny and regulatory pressure on PBM business practices, which could impact operational compliance and pricing transparency for self-funded plan sponsors operating in the state.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Wed, 11 Nov 2026 21:50:10 GMT
